why: Only the max - min spread inside a team matters, so sort the skills; then the best team containing the weakest unused developer is the next teamSize developers in sorted order. Greedily form a team whenever that block fits within maxDiff, otherwise drop the weakest.
hints: Order does not matter, only each team's max - min. What does sorting give you?

After sorting, a team should be teamSize consecutive values. If the block starting at the smallest remaining value fits (last - first <= maxDiff), taking it never hurts; if it doesn't fit, that smallest value can't be in any team.
Sort, then walk an index i: if s[i+teamSize-1] - s[i] <= maxDiff count a team and jump by teamSize, else step by 1. O(n log n).
pitfalls: The limit is inclusive: a spread exactly equal to maxDiff is allowed.
teamSize = 1: every developer is a team.
Developers left over at the end are simply unused.
